sensory-friendly mass invitation /g228 st colmcille’s parish (ballyhackamore belfast bt4 3jb) warmly inv ites you to our monthly sensory mass on saturday, 31st october at 12:00 noon. this special mass is designed to be inclusive and welcoming for individuals and families who may benefit from a quieter, more relaxed worship environment. the short mass will feature: gentle lighting and sound; a calm and supportive atmosphere; space to move around if needed; sensory items to aid regulation; a warm welcome for all ag es and abilities. whether you or a loved one experience sensory sensitivities, or you simply wish to attend a short peaceful and reflective service, we would love to see you there. refreshments after mass. as always we had a great collection of food and donations of £506. we sent 2 tesco orders to the foodbank with multiples of the following items:- long life milk, juice, coffee, oats, tins of stewing steak, beef casserole, chicken in white sauce, tinned vegetables, tinned fruit, biscuits, shampoo, shower gel, toothpaste, washing detergent. thank you so much for your unwavering support every month. our next collection will be 31st oct & 1st november short-term pledge the month of november offers a special opportunity to make a small sacrifice in honour of the sacred heart of jesus. we invite parishioners and friends to consider taking a short-term pledge throughout november. pioneer offering - "i promise, in honour of the sacred heart of jesus, and with the help of the blessed virgin mary, to abstain from all intoxicating substances until the end of november." please consider joining with others in prayer, sacrifice and support for those affected by addiction.
